questions.question: What is Habakkuk 3?
options: A list of woes against Babylon

questions.question: How does Habakkuk resolve to respond even if the crops fail and the flocks are gone?
options: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD; I will take joy in the God of my salvation
Yet I will flee away to the high mountains in search of a sure refuge
Yet I will turn entirely away and trust only in my own strength
Yet I will mourn deeply in sackcloth and weep aloud in my great grief
questions.answer: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD; I will take joy in the God of my salvation

questions.question: Habakkuk says God is his strength, who makes his feet like the deer's and lets him tread on the heights.
Though the fig tree should not blossom... yet I will rejoice in the _____.
O LORD, I have heard the report of You; I stand in _____ of Your deeds.
